accepted_parent.scope: one fixed two-hour mission at h8-10 requiring both of two ready aircraft, no ordinary failures, seed1, horizon36

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp192-193 and 437-439: DAMP is per-mission probability, at most one occurrence per damage type during a mission, with occurrence time drawn within the mission; systems in a mission are treated as independent damage individuals. DamageItem.PROB=0 specifies no consequence (pp425-426).
source_delta: The control is byte-identical to accepted A03. The child adds DamageType BATTLE-HIT, MissionDamage DAMP=1/DAMRT=null for BASIC-MISSION and TEACH-AIR-01, and DamageItem <ATTRITION>/PROB=0. Only ProblemDescription changes among existing tables. Formation quantity2, one fixed mission, seed1, no ordinary failures, and horizon36 are unchanged.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: The native control should convert with zero errors and launch both aircraft at h8, succeed at h10, and produce 72 half-hour System/Stock bins with four aircraft-hours.
pre_run_hypotheses.damp: If each aircraft receives its own per-mission DAMP=1 occurrence draw, the log should show one BATTLE-HIT occurrence on each of aircraft IDs 0 and 1, at distinct times strictly within h8-10. The zero-probability consequence should leave the formation successful and both aircraft ready. Exact stochastic times are not preaccepted.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, only one aircraft event, duplicate events on one aircraft, no event, identical/ambiguous timestamps, prelaunch damage, attrition or abort is diagnostic only for the predeclared two-aircraft claim. A successful process exit alone is not acceptance.

acceptance_gates: Independent static review of frozen source, exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner before native execution
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 13/16 authored row-containing table roundtrips (including three all-null placeholders in each arm), zero converter errors and valid SXO/event/report in both arms
One BATTLE-HIT event per aircraft at distinct in-flight times, no attrition/abort, and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: One seed and one guaranteed-probability two-aircraft mission can show per-aircraft events and different sampled times, not statistical independence or population timing law.
No positive consequence, item/system damage or repair, intermediate DAMP, other formation sizes, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity is tested.
